_comment: USD per million tokens, by model-id prefix (longest matching prefix wins).
Prices change; this is data precisely so a stale number is a one-line edit and never
a code change. If a run reports $0.00 for a model, its prefix is missing here — add it.
cache_write multiplies the input rate (a cache write costs more than a plain input token).
cache_read multiplies the input rate (a cache hit costs a small fraction). The whole point
of putting briefs on disk and keeping launch commands to one line is to drive cache_read
up and everything else down — Cloudflare reported an 85.7% cache hit rate.
